abilities.name: Rika

abilities.name: Copy

abilities.description: Commands spoken with cursed energy that force targets to obey.

abilities.name: Reverse Cursed Technique
abilities.description: Allows Yuta to heal himself and output positive energy to heal others.

abilities.name: Sky Manipulation
abilities.description: Lets Yuta control the sky as a tangible surface and manipulate space.

abilities.name: Technique Extinguishment
abilities.description: Nullifies cursed techniques and other jujutsu.

abilities.name: Jacob's Ladder
abilities.description: A pillar of light that extinguishes cursed techniques under it.

abilities.name: Swordsmanship
